sources.title: Ecommerce Link Building That Actually Drives Revenue | SEOasis | SEOasis
sources.note: HTTP 200 public HTML sample. Commercial positioning prioritizes collection pages and revenue over backlink-count reporting; do not treat marketing assertions about links or AI causality as established facts.

sources.title: Interview with Mike Sack on organic shopping - Productrise Blog
sources.note: Accessible first-person Q&A with Mike Sack, hosted by a vendor he uses. He discusses boutique delivery, supplemental feeds, images/title experiments, and uncertainty in durable AI tactics. Vendor-hosted results are self-reported.

sources.note: Public case library includes collection work, technical hack cleanup, AI referral revenue, organic Shopping, and blog-related results. Statistics are self-reported; baselines and causal attribution require source-system validation.

sources.note: Commercial methodology page outlines audit/build/grow, collection production, schema, Reddit and AI monitoring. Its no-blog/no-backlink positioning differs from partner coordination in the role listing. Technical and outcome assertions are SEOasis claims, not independently established facts.

sources.title: AI-Focused Shopify SEO Agency | SEOasis
sources.note: Live homepage: Shopify/ecommerce AEO positioning; team identities; collection, Reddit, foundation/monitoring pillars; quarterly recalibration and client reporting cadence. Outcome claims are company-reported.

findings.title: Collection-first authority positioning
findings.evidence: The ecommerce link-building page explicitly prioritizes collection buildout and organic revenue over backlink-count reporting.
findings.businessImplication: Fit authority work to the account strategy; do not create a placement quota merely because a public link-building URL exists.

findings.title: A named external founder interview exists
findings.evidence: The company-research workstream verified a Productrise-hosted Q&A identifying Mike Sack and discussing organic Shopping.
findings.businessImplication: An attributable external venue provides discoverable expertise. Vendor-hosted interview results are self-reported, and one interview does not establish broad authority.

findings.title: Public case evidence provides a starting point
findings.evidence: SEOasis publishes a case-study library, including collection, technical, AI referral and organic Shopping themes. Outcomes are company-reported.
findings.businessImplication: Reuse approved proof with dates, method and limitations; do not convert published results into independently audited attribution.

findings.title: Confirm where link-building partners fit
findings.evidence: The job includes link-building coordination; current commercial copy deemphasizes backlink outreach. This may reflect account-specific needs or a change in positioning.
findings.recommendedAction: Confirm current deliverables, partner ownership, quality criteria and budget before commissioning authority work.

findings.title: Backlink health and referral value are unmeasured here
findings.evidence: No Search Console link export, Ahrefs/Semrush export or analytics referral history was obtained.
findings.businessImplication: No backlink count, domain rating, authority score or missing-link claim is asserted.

No claim that a Reddit mention causes training ingestion, AI recommendations or incremental revenue.
No deceptive account, endorsement, voting, spam or engagement automation recommendation.
synthesisNotes: Confirm current link-building partner scope with Mike; public role and commercial positioning may have different account scopes.
Use community questions to inform collection hypotheses; validate catalog and buyer intent before page production.
Keep referral outcomes, branded search movement and AI citations as separate measurements.
